input: Research local fostering options for a senior cat

gold.taskTitle: Research local fostering options for a senior cat
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate local organizations or individuals that offer fostering arrangements specifically suited to a senior cat.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location to narrow down local fostering organizations and contacts.

questions.title: How old is the cat you need fostered?
questions.description: Confirm the cat's age to ensure the fostering options are appropriate for a senior animal.

questions.title: How long do you need the foster arrangement to last?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a short-term, long-term, or open-ended fostering need.

questions.title: Why does the cat need fostering right now?
questions.description: Understand the reason behind the fostering need, such as a move, medical situation, or travel.

questions.title: Does the cat have any medical conditions needing special care?
questions.description: Identify health issues that a foster home would need to accommodate, such as medication or mobility needs.

questions.title: Are you looking to foster out your cat or foster one yourself?
questions.description: Clarify the direction of the fostering relationship to research the correct type of organization or program.

questions.title: Do you have a budget for fostering-related costs?
questions.description: Determine whether cost is a constraint, as some foster programs are free while others involve fees.
